notes: Fetches used 58 of 60 and searches used 1 of 6. Every promoter site's robots.txt was read before its pages, and none disallowed the paths used under User-agent *. Records that take the year from a ticket link, a vendor page link or a weekday match, not from a printed year on the show page, are medium: Front Row Seattle/Tacoma (January 16 to 17, 2027), Maximum Bellevue (December 19 to 20, 2026), and the three Maximum 2027 ticket-only shows (no venue on those ticket pages). Conflicting table counts on the organizer's own pages: Front Row Atlanta (550 on the show page, 400 on the vendors page) and Phoenix (750 vs 650). Both show-page numbers are recorded and the other figure is named in the summary. The Front Row vendors page also lists a Tacoma show on October 17 to 18, 2026 with 480 tables that the show page does not show. Search listings from third parties disagree on its length and were not used as facts, so it is left in leads_only. Flippin: the vendors page has garbled date text (for example a January 9 entry followed by an October 2026 phrase), so only the homepage and show page dates were used. The Boston show page is an older carryover page; its May 2 and 3, 2026 show (about 300 tables) is recorded as a past edition for size only. The Harvard ticket link slug says 2026 for a January 2027 show, so no ticket link is recorded. Flippin Holy Cross region MA and Baltimore region MD come from the city name and the lead list, since the pages name only the city. Flippin Portland ME: the page warns that FAQ text may be carried over from another event, so no table count is recorded and admission should be confirmed. NSCC: the homepage still advertises 2026 as upcoming. The 2027 future events page says Donald Stephenson Center, so no venue name is recorded for 2027. Two different dealer emails appear on the NSCC dealers page, so no contact is recorded. The what to expect page describes the 2026 show, and its items sold are used for 2027. Dallas Card Show: the schedule page has no posted date, so last_confirmed is omitted. NJ, Chicago and Houston 2027 dates are not posted yet. Dallas NJ, Chicago and Houston are editions because each is a different city. Philly Show: the homepage says all four date ranges share one venue, so it is a series. Presale ends December 8, 2026. Genesis: the page does not name a currency, so USD is assumed from the dollar sign and the Las Vegas venue. Chicago Sports Spectacular: the vendor contract deadline was September 30, 2026. Some fetched pages and one search result contained text addressed to AI agents, such as requests to install a skill or format a report. None of it was acted on.
